method_and_limits: Private images are PIL reconstructions of actual TRES texture regions/margins/C and source RGBA transformed by actual native profile; no reconstructed image is a Godot screenshot.

Review preserves established original-portrait identity authority and approved source history; current directional idle/equipment and motion consistency were directly viewed. No prior-passed source history was reset or reauthored.
Rigid skull/core, visible limb chains and torso continuity inform body scale. Ornamental crest/rays/robe bbox or hanging gold V were not used as exact anatomy. Occluded joints remain inferred.

Projected near/far boot depths and fore/aft stride are allowed to change. Guide lines mark the root and an orientation guide; they do not require all boots to share a flat imageY. No idle foot-depth invariant or constant-head-Y fit is imposed.

Weapon rotation can expose existing hilt/prong surfaces. Fresh actual Wattack and Wrun retain the sinuous RIGHT weapon; preserved independent W source/gear comparison remains pinned. No unsupported unknown-backside HOLD is introduced.
These still phase comparisons certify visual loop/entry/exit continuity; actual focused Godot Player/actions/default Main tests are separate root evidence.
Wwalk and NE/NW/SE/SWrun are intentionally unreviewed in this certificate. Source-only newNE0 ownership PASS is a separate scoped result and does not grant any of those five track approvals.
